name: media/spotify-play
description: Bring Spotify up and play the current track - but only press Play if it is not already playing.

steps.note: Reuses a running Spotify. Its window title is 'Spotify Premium' when idle and the track name while playing, so 'Spotify' is only reliable when it is idle - `open` falls back to launching, which Spotify turns into focusing the existing instance.

else.note: EXACT 'Play': every track row is a button named 'Play <song> by <artist>', and a substring match would start a different song. The player bar's own button is the only one called just 'Play'. The expect proves it started: the button turns into 'Pause'.
